senses.gloss:
जुगुप्सनं, जुगुप्सा
1 Censure,
reproach.
--2 Dislike, aversion,
disgust, abhorrence.
--3 (In Rhet.)
Disgust considered as the feeling
which gives rise to the Bībhatsa
sentiment, thus defined:
--दोषेक्षणादिभिर्गर्हा जुगुप्सा विषयोद्भवा S. D. 207.
